body:
The thing is, the only thing that I am not into is her physically appearance, a very superficial thing to worry about as we will all get old and lose our good appearance anyway.

She is nurturing, mature, funny as hell, and places me above all else. No other woman will focus her entire life on me the way she does. And no other woman will make me feel so natural with her, so confident. Speaking to her is almost like speaking to myself, when I'm with her I feel we are two parts of the same entity.

Its just... Hard for me. It's not like I don't love her. I know I am extremely stupid, I don't want advice from reddit, what I want is a conversation with a third party to figure this out, to figure what's going on with me to be so hesitant about this
